Initial release of smyx-reptile-shedding-progress-analysis:

- Provides automatic reptile shedding phase detection using periodic high-definition enclosure images and AI visual analysis (body color, eye state).
- Classifies shedding stages: normal, preparation (whitish skin, opaque eyes), in-progress, completed, and identifies dysecdysis (stuck shed) warnings.
- Analyzes environmental factors (humidity, moist hide visibility, rough objects) and highlights high-risk areas (toes, tail tip, eye caps).
- Enforces strict image requirements, privacy, and open-id authentication with multi-step verification.
- Delivers multi-level care recommendations and visualized shedding timelines.
- Integrates automatic daily or semi-daily analysis, automatic report saving, and secure historical report querying.
